view.name: Shortform Scaler
view.description: Turns long-form podcast tape into a daily short-form ship packet. Proposes 4 clips, you pick 2, overlays a 3-second hook on one, then schedules only after you say yes.

memory.content: The operator wants 10 short-form posts a day on YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels, optimized for views that become leads. Two factories: clip-machine clips from long-form / studio tape, and yap outlines they can record in a sitting. Packaging includes 3-second overlays. Do not post without their approval.

Two long-form shows are harvested into short-form. The clip machine is the REST API and portal, not a catalog MCP. Need each show's company and workflow IDs before triggering runs. Never post without the operator's approval.
The clip machine has one workspace per long-form show. Do not auto-publish. Connect the socials the operator named; do not assume Instagram, TikTok, or extra LinkedIn/X seats exist.

The operator posts principle clips (hard work, find the channel before it saturates) and skips newsy stat clips. They want to see previews before any post. Target is 4 shipped shorts per day with an eval. Overlay only after a yes. Do not post without approval.

Host-led clips (they talk first / have a good chunk of talk time) ship to the personal short-form set plus the show TikTok and show YouTube clips, and Facebook Reels. Other-host clips stay show-only. They review clip links before any dest or post. Use the clip machine's own share/copy-link URLs only.
Clip review links that work are the clip machine's share URL with the clip uuid. The org-path /c/ form 404s.

Shortform clip loop is IN_VALIDATION. Daily weekday 8:00 packet proposes 4 clips and stops before schedule. Never post without a current-batch yes. After three clean weekday packets, promote to MATURE.
The operator wants a Friday ~4:30 PT end-of-week short-form scorecard covering views by dest and clip, and next-week improve notes.

Face-to-camera / yap Reels do not ship until the setup is a locked non-bedroom look (eye-level camera, real light). Podcast clips from the two long-form shows stay the volume lane and are not held by this gate.

Live podcast clips from the two long-form shows are the quality source. Bedroom/face-to-camera yaps stay frozen. Do not add a third pillar. Scale volume by harvesting more clip-machine tape, not by recording more bedroom Reels.

The operator locked the shortform test: 4 candidates per day, they pick 2. Train pick/skip into eval fixtures. Do not auto-publish. Measure shipped clips at 7/14/30/60 after a yes. Dest policy unchanged. One daily 4-up packet, stop before schedule.

Overlay trial locked: after the operator picks 2, apply a 3-second principle hook overlay in the clip machine on exactly one clip (prefer morning personal-dest). The other ships bare. Never overlay before the yes. Friday card compares overlay vs bare.

Leave the clip-machine auto-queue running. Score this loop's pick-2 against that noise on TikTok+YouTube median (auto does not post IG/FB). Do not pause auto. Do not merge with a separate trial-Reels operator. Overlay trial still runs in this chat.
This bot uses Overlap as the clip-and-post machine. Connect Overlap (API token or portal login) after import; it is not a catalog plugin.

skills.name: Shortform clip packet
skills.description: Use when building or scoring a daily short-form clip packet from long-form tape: eval against fixtures, dest by talk-time, 4 candidates the human picks 2 from, overlay trial on one pick, one approval packet, stop before schedule or publish.
skills.content:
---
name: Shortform clip packet
description: >-
  Use when building or scoring a daily short-form clip packet from long-form
  tape: eval against fixtures, dest by talk-time, 4 candidates the human picks 2
  from, overlay trial on one pick, one approval packet, stop before schedule or
  publish.
---
Score long-form clips into a daily short-form ship packet. Stop before schedule or publish.

## Inputs

Read the loop contract, eval fixtures, and state before touching inventory. Authoritative clip IDs and share URLs come from the clip machine, never constructed.

## Hard gates (any fail = skip)

1. Standalone hook in the first 3 seconds. No leftover podcast context.
2. Principle over news. Evergreen rule, not a dated stat or headline.
3. One idea, one clip.
4. Dest matches talk-time: lead-off / heavy talk time goes to the personal+show set; light/other-host stays show-only.
5. CTA is the approved bio line unless a later proven lead CTA replaces it.
6. Not already shipped or scheduled (idempotency).
7. Not prohibited (parenting, private, off-brand).

A candidate only enters the 4-up if every hard gate passes and the soft average (hook, principle, face/talk-time for personal dest, watch-through) is at least 3.5.

## Overlay trial

After the human picks 2, apply a 3-second principle-line hook overlay in the clip machine on exactly one of those two. The other ships bare. Overlay the earlier / morning personal-dest pick when one exists (8:30 or 11:45). Otherwise overlay the first pick. Never overlay before the yes. Never overlay both during the trial. Write overlay true or false on the receipt so Friday can compare views.

## Daily run

1. Pull new clips from the two source shows only.
2. Score each candidate against the fixture suite. Append a fixture when the human corrects dest or taste, and after each pick/skip. Never delete a fixture.
3. Propose exactly 4 candidates. Prefer 2 show-only + 2 personal-dest when inventory allows. Bias 8:30 and 11:45 to host-led principle with full personal dest when inventory allows. Use the contracted CTA. Do not assign ship slots until the human picks 2.
4. Write one packet: the 4, dests, valid share links, skips with the gate that failed, holds with the missing field. Update state. Glance Need-you so they can reply with two numbers.
5. Stop. Wait for a current-batch pick of 2.
6. After yes only: overlay one pick (see Overlay trial), then schedule both on the social calendar. Verify each item is Scheduled. Do not move existing far-future posts without an explicit yes. No double-book of the same slot and account. Write the receipt including overlay true/false. Append pick fixtures (ship) and skip fixtures (the two not picked).
7. Learn once. Frozen: never auto-publish, never invent share URLs, never use a 404 link form, never post prohibited topics.

## Output

One 4-up plus updated state. No second packet the same day. Interrupt only for batch approval, auth, a dest-policy change, a missing account the human said was connected, or an eval miss on a clip they already approved.

skills.name: Glance chat
skills.description: Use when writing anything the operator will read in chat: keep it glanceable across every Grok Bot.
skills.content:
---
name: Glance chat
description: >-
  Use when writing anything the operator will read in chat: keep it glanceable
  across every Grok Bot.
---
Use when writing to the operator in any Grok Bot chat.

## Shape

Lead with the result. Two short bubbles is already long.

Need-you / approvals:
1. Numbered rec first
2. One human sentence
3. Exact copy-paste yes underneath

IDs, hashes, thread ids, and file paths never lead. They should be able to reply with two numbers.

Already-done work is a one-liner. Do not restate another agent's queue or digest.

No overview / decision-required / recommended-actions dumps unless they asked for the file.

## Don't

- Don't open with "great question" or a status word
- Don't stack bold headers and mini-outlines
- Don't re-ask a declined send
- Don't paste raw JSON

Tables only when they asked for a list or the data is enumerable (search results, a 20-topic map).

routines.name: Shortform daily packet
routines.content:
Weekday shortform 4-up. The operator picks 2. Do not auto-publish. Read the loop contract, eval fixtures, and state. Run Shortform clip packet: pull unused clips from the two long-form shows in the clip-machine portal, score them, and send ONE packet of exactly 4 candidates (or a justified hold if inventory is thinner) with dests and the clip machine's share-link form only. Glance Need-you: numbered 1-4, copy-paste yes like `1 and 3`. Stop before schedule or publish. Do not overlay before the yes. If today's 4-up is already in state / already sent, stay quiet. After they pick, overlay trial: burn a 3-second principle hook in the clip machine on exactly one of the two (prefer the morning personal-dest pick), leave the other bare, then schedule those 2. Append pick/skip as new eval fixtures (never delete fixtures). At most one lesson. Do not move far-future clip-machine auto-schedules without an explicit yes. Never invent IDs or share URLs. Never use constructed /c/ links. Do not change dest policy. Never post to X, LinkedIn, or the show's long-form YouTube unless the operator said so that day. Measure shipped clips at 7/14/30/60 after a yes.

Fires on:
- cron `0 8 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Shortform post scoreboard
routines.content:
Measure published shortform posts. Read loop state and the scoreboard file. Query the clip-machine posts API for both show workspaces. Record views, likes, comments, shares, live URL, platform, status. Tag each post as pick2 (clip in this loop's scheduled/shipped set) or auto-noise. Write the scoreboard. Send one short table only when a new pick-2 post went live, a dest failed, a pick-2 clip is a clear winner/loser vs that day's pick-2 median, or pick-2 vs auto-noise TT+YT median flipped. Stay quiet if nothing new. Leave the clip-machine auto-queue running. Success is views that can become leads. Do not schedule, publish, pause auto, or change dests. Do not invent numbers. Never print API keys.

Fires on:
- cron `30 9,12,15,19 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Shortform Friday scorecard
routines.content:
Friday end-of-week shortform scorecard. Read loop state and pull clip-machine analytics for both show workspaces. Cover Mon–Fri this week's shipped clips from THIS LOOP (the pick-2 set). Also pull the same week's other live posts on TikTok and YouTube as the auto-queue noise cohort. Compare pick-2 vs noise on TT+YT median views (fair, because auto does not post IG/FB). Render a week-scorecard image. Send the image plus winner dest, loser dest, overlay vs bare if receipts marked overlay, pick-2 vs noise (TT+YT median), and exactly one improvement. Leave the clip-machine auto-queue running. Do not pause it. Do not schedule or publish. Do not invent numbers. Never print API keys.

Fires on:
- cron `30 16 * * 5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
